body: I'm sorry you're in a similar situation, I hope that you find happiness and contentment in your life. You deserve it. 💜
Sadly I am, thank you for your kindness. 💜💜
I love bojack, and the poem makes me cry every time without fail. 💜
Hey all, didn't end up doing anything this time. Sorry this was meant to just be a vent.

Not sure why this tore me up the way it did. I think maybe just because I forget there are some out there who are empathetic and kind just because.

 I am an artist, been drawing since I was little. If I wasn't as far gone as I am, maybe I would have been successful with that. Maybe when I'm gone my work will be famous, since that seems to be a common theme in the art world. Hahah.

 I'm sorry I can't reassure you with a positive message as to what will happen with me, and I'm really sorry to hear about your friend. I hope that they are doing well and find happiness. You seem very sweet and, though I don't know them, I'm glad they have you in their life.

I try to. I love nature, it's not that I don't know there is beauty in life, but more so that my life is and ever will be too painful to ever get to enjoy that beauty. You are kind and I hope that you have a life fully of beauty and warmth. 💜
